_meta.purpose: Registry of news sources for the fiscal-news aggregation layer. The ingestion script (ingest_news.py) reads this, fetches each feed, and writes link+snippet-only news_items to news-feed.json. Nothing here republishes article text.

rules.tos: Only RSS/official APIs that permit aggregation. Record ingest_source for auditability.
rules.lean: outlet_lean must come from a published, citable media-bias assessment (lean_source). Where none exists, use 'unknown'. Lean is the aggregation of third-party assessments, never our editorial verdict.
rules.store: link + short snippet (outlet's own summary / first ~40 words) only — never full text.

feeds.lean_source: Government of India official channel — categorised as state communication, not independent media.
feeds.note: Official scheme launches, fund-release announcements. Tier-1/2 anchor for the 'sanction'/'release' end of a chain.

feeds.lean_source: Multiple published India media-bias assessments classify The Hindu as centre-left; recorded as third-party aggregation, not our judgement.
Third-party media-bias aggregations classify IE around centre; recorded as aggregation.
Wire service; treated as centre/neutral by convention. Marked aggregation.
No widely-cited bias assessment found; left as unknown rather than guessed. Strong on scheme/rural-development reporting (MGNREGS, water).
No single citable bias assessment applied to the Hindi edition; left unknown. Hindi-language coverage — powers cross-language blindspot detection.
No citable bias assessment for the regional edition; left unknown. Bengali-language — critical for West Bengal districts (Birbhum, Kolkata) blindspot detection.
No citable bias assessment for the regional edition; left unknown. Tamil-language — for Tamil Nadu district coverage.
No citable bias assessment for the regional edition; left unknown. Telugu-language — for Andhra Pradesh / Telangana districts.
No citable bias assessment for the regional edition; left unknown. Marathi-language — for Maharashtra districts.

notes: URLs are the publicly-advertised RSS endpoints; all regional feeds re-verified live (200 + real RSS) on 2026-06-24 — see each feed's 'verified' field. Regional-language feeds power the coverage-bar 'blindspot' detection (an event covered only in English vs. also in Bengali/Hindi etc.). KNOWN LIMITATION: ingest_news.py auto-anchors by matching Latin-script district/scheme names, so it won't auto-anchor headlines written in Indian scripts — those ingest as 'unanchored' and must be anchored by hand in curate.html. A future transliteration/alias step would close this. Verify ToS before enabling any feed.
